title: Handlers live in src/<thing>/
summary: Aaron's call: implementation/handlers is gone. A project's handlers are src/<thing>/<operation>.ts, mirroring blueprint/things/<thing>/, and later layers put a thing's contract and workflows in the same folder. The scaffolder, generate, the generated server, check and its lint rules, brief, the preset and the docs all follow.
proves: prove passes on acme and on the starter, check passes on acme, tools/e2e/starter.sh passes in a fresh workspace, and a scaffolded handler lands in src/<thing>/ under its 'Scaffolded from' header.

captions.01-prove-acme: architect prove on acme, handlers read from src/.
captions.03-check-acme: architect check on acme: rules now target src/.
captions.04-scaffold: generate and render tests: scaffolds land in src/<thing>/; the header of a scaffolded handler.
captions.05-starter-e2e: tools/e2e/starter.sh: the preset writes src/, check and prove pass in the new workspace.
